title: Lemma 8.1.3, printed (1)–(2): differentiation of the β-weighted slices of V
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (β : C(Grassmannian N n, ℝ)), (∀ S, 0 ≤ β S) → ∃ e : Euclidean N → ℝ, Measurable e ∧ (∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ ↦ (∫ z in closedBall x ρ ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)), β z.2 ∂V.measure) / (V.weight (closedBall x ρ)).toReal) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (e x))) ∧ ∀ A : Set (Euclidean N), MeasurableSet A → ∫⁻ z in A ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)), ENNReal.ofReal (β z.2) ∂V.measure = ∫⁻ x in A, ENNReal.ofReal (e x) ∂V.weight
